assign.outcome:
**The floor lands: every tab set on the site now shows its panel by default.** `ext/tabs/tabs.css` gates the proposal's rules on `:not(.underline):not(.vertical)` instead of an opt-in `.panel` class — a bounded surface (background, 1px frame, radius), the strip's own rule as the panel's top edge, the selected tab cut out of it (its bottom border painted the panel's own colour, so there is no seam). `.ac("underline")` is the one word back to the old transparent strip; it needs no CSS of its own. `.vertical` gets its own simpler floor (its rail shape is untouched — composing the blanket default there would have out-specified it). A `:has()` rule closes the box's top when a single-tab set hides its own bar. Verified by computed-style probe on `/framework/ext/Panel/`: panel background and the selected tab's border-bottom-color both `rgb(242,242,242)` (`--tab-fill` already `--wash` on `.page.doc-page`, from before this task). Composes with `.block` by specificity (3 classes beat 2), so Doc's folder-tab top bar gets the floor with its own type untouched.

32 files import `ext/tabs`. Six shot before/after at 1280 and 3440 in [`shots/`](shots/): [`/framework/ext/Panel/`](/framework/ext/Panel/) (Doc page, `.block` bar), [`/framework/core/Page/`](/framework/core/Page/) (Doc page), `/imagine/mag/` and `/blog/systems/layout-generators/` (unrelated controls — byte-identical before/after), [`/imagine/paging/mechanisms/swap/`](/imagine/paging/mechanisms/swap/) (the reference — also byte-identical, its own local classes untouched), [`/framework/ext/tabs/`](/framework/ext/tabs/) (this module's own demo — the clearest before/after: transparent underline becomes a bordered white box against the checkerboard). Zero console errors across all 24 after-shots.

`ui-test` on `/framework/ext/tabs/`: clicked Overview → API → Docs → Overview. The panel's `x`/`y`/`width` held exactly constant across all four reads (only height moved, with the content); the selected tab's `border-bottom-color` equalled the panel's `background-color` every time (`match: true` × 4). Zero console errors on any step. Evidence: [`ui-test-out/steps.json`](ui-test-out/steps.json).

**Documented:** `readme.md` (the one line: what the panel looks like now, `.underline` for the old look) and `doc/decisions.md` (the 2026-09-05 record: the mechanism, why `.vertical` is separate, the asymmetric padding call, what was checked and found safe).

**Left open, with reason:** the reference realm's own `.paging-tab*` classes in `/imagine/paging/paging.css` should now drop for `ext/tabs`'s own — the proposal said so and this task agrees — but two of the three call sites (`demos.js`, `make/tabs.js`) sit outside this task's fence (only `mechanisms/swap/` and `paging.css` were open to it), so removing the shared rules would break them. Left for a follow-up with a wider fence. `.tab-panel`'s pre-floor top padding (3em) was kept as-is rather than unified to the pad token on all four sides, to protect the site's existing vertical rhythm under every tab set including Doc pages; a future pass could revisit once someone looks hard at it against a visible border.
